workflow.cancellation: This one-command projection has no wait or cancellation node. Cancel or postpone the external GitLab issue according to PROCESS.md and capture the resulting decision in a new complete report.
workflow.revision_restart: This graph has no loop. Rework and later reports are separate external revisions/new report-capture requests; a new request must bind the exact current method snapshot and must not imply that a prior report was accepted.
workflow.semantics: One-command capture of a complete, externally authored product-development report. This graph does not run or advance the external GitLab lifecycle, authenticate assertions, review changes, execute Git or CI, deploy software, or decide product acceptance.
